fields.title: 📖 Tašrīʿ without Allah’s permission
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Do they have partners who have prescribed for them a religion that Allah has not permitted? And do not say falsely: This is ḥalāl and this is ḥarām, in order to invent a lie against Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ḥalāl and Ḥarām belong to Allah alone. Whoever sets his own norms as Dīn, or permits and forbids in Allah’s name, enters the domain of Tašrīʿ and of lying against Allah.
